evaluations.evidence: create a new game
evaluations.rationale: The story creates the game entity; no prior story dependency is inherent.

evaluations.evidence: giving them a URL where they can access the game
evaluations.rationale: Inviting estimators inherently requires an existing game to access.

evaluations.evidence: start a round
evaluations.rationale: Starting a round inherently requires an existing game session.

evaluations.evidence: see all items we try to estimate this session
evaluations.rationale: Viewing the session item list requires a game session and items added to the list.

evaluations.evidence: select an item to be estimated
evaluations.rationale: Selecting an item requires an existing list of items in a game.

evaluations.evidence: add an item to the list of items to be estimated
evaluations.rationale: Adding an item to a session list requires an existing game/session to add it to.

evaluations.evidence: edit an item in the list
evaluations.rationale: Editing an item requires an existing item in the list.

evaluations.evidence: delete an item from the list
evaluations.rationale: Deleting an item requires an existing item in the list.

evaluations.evidence: show all estimates immediately
evaluations.rationale: Showing estimates requires a game session and estimates that have been given.

evaluations.evidence: accept the average of all estimates
evaluations.rationale: Accepting an average requires estimates that have been given in a game session.

evaluations.evidence: estimate field filled in automatically if all estimators show the same card
evaluations.rationale: Requires estimates or card selections from all estimators in a game.

evaluations.evidence: enter the agreed-upon estimate
evaluations.rationale: Requires a current item or round to attach the estimate to.

evaluations.evidence: estimate a story we estimated earlier in the session again
evaluations.rationale: Requires an earlier estimated story and prior estimation history.

evaluations.evidence: import stories from a spreadsheet
evaluations.rationale: Importing stories into a session requires an existing game/session.

evaluations.evidence: copy/paste stories from a spreadsheet
evaluations.rationale: Pasting stories into a session requires an existing game/session.

evaluations.evidence: browse through previous games
evaluations.rationale: Browsing previous games inherently requires existing games.

evaluations.evidence: view a transcript of a game
evaluations.rationale: Viewing a transcript inherently requires a game and its recorded rounds or estimates.

evaluations.evidence: export a transcript of a game as a HTML file
evaluations.rationale: Exporting a transcript depends on an existing transcript or game.

evaluations.evidence: export a transcript of a game as a CSV file
evaluations.rationale: Exporting a transcript depends on an existing transcript or game.

evaluations.evidence: delete a game
evaluations.rationale: Deleting a game inherently requires an existing game.

evaluations.evidence: create an account
evaluations.rationale: Account creation is the starting point for account-related stories.

evaluations.evidence: log in using my account name and password
evaluations.rationale: Login requires an existing account.

evaluations.evidence: change my account details
evaluations.rationale: Changing account details requires an existing account.

evaluations.evidence: delete my account
evaluations.rationale: Deleting an account requires an existing account.

evaluations.evidence: see dates and times in my local timezone
evaluations.rationale: Timezone preference is cross-cutting and does not depend on a concrete prior story to be implemented first.

evaluations.evidence: get a password reminder by email
evaluations.rationale: Password reminder requires an existing account.

evaluations.evidence: select whether to have the team estimate with
evaluations.rationale: Selecting an estimation scale requires a game or team session to configure.

evaluations.evidence: invite up to 15 estimators
evaluations.rationale: Inviting estimators requires an existing game or session.

evaluations.evidence: join a game by entering my name on the page I received the URL for
evaluations.rationale: Joining requires an existing game and invitation URL.

evaluations.evidence: see the item we're estimating
evaluations.rationale: Seeing the current item requires a selected item or round in a game.

evaluations.evidence: see all items we will try to estimate this session
evaluations.rationale: Requires the session item list to be populated.

evaluations.evidence: immediately see that an estimate has been given
evaluations.rationale: Requires a game session and estimate submission by a specific estimator.

evaluations.evidence: shown all estimates at the same time after all estimators have given their estimate
evaluations.rationale: Requires a game session and collected estimates from estimators.

evaluations.evidence: change my estimate up until the last person selects a card and all are shown
evaluations.rationale: Changing an estimate presupposes an existing estimate and a reveal mechanism.

evaluations.evidence: see each estimator's prior estimates for the story being estimated
evaluations.rationale: Requires a selected story and prior estimates from earlier in the session.

evaluations.evidence: see who gave what estimates during the current round
evaluations.rationale: Requires the current round's estimates to exist.

evaluations.evidence: start a two-minute countdown timer that all participants can see
evaluations.rationale: The timer occurs during an estimation game and requires an existing game or session with participants.

evaluations.evidence: two-minute timer reset itself as soon as we all play an estimate
evaluations.rationale: Depends on the timer feature and on estimates being played.

evaluations.evidence: scroll back through the stories and estimates from prior rounds
evaluations.rationale: Requires prior rounds and estimates to exist for the game.

evaluations.evidence: always have the cards in the same order across multiple draws
evaluations.rationale: Card ordering consistency is self-contained; no concrete prerequisite story is identified.

evaluations.evidence: change my estimate as long as the draw has not been completed
evaluations.rationale: Presupposes an existing estimate and an ongoing draw in a game.

evaluations.evidence: small thumbnail photo displayed near where my cards are played
evaluations.rationale: Displaying a photo is self-contained; no concrete prerequisite story is cited.

evaluations.evidence: site is compliant with XHTML and CSS standards
evaluations.rationale: Cross-cutting technical quality requirement; no story-level dependency.

evaluations.evidence: list of definitions for commonly used terms
evaluations.rationale: Self-contained reference content; no prerequisite story.

evaluations.evidence: database indexes
evaluations.rationale: Technical performance work; no user story dependency identified.

evaluations.evidence: function correctly in Internet Explorer 6 and 7, Firefox 1.5 and 2, and Safari 2
evaluations.rationale: Browser compatibility is cross-cutting; no concrete prerequisite story.

evaluations.evidence: comply with the W3C accessibility guidelines
evaluations.rationale: Accessibility is cross-cutting; no concrete prerequisite story.

evaluations.evidence: application respond quickly
evaluations.rationale: Performance is cross-cutting; no concrete prerequisite story.

evaluations.evidence: use Unicode
evaluations.rationale: Internationalization is cross-cutting; no concrete prerequisite story.

evaluations.evidence: sensible and predictable URLs
evaluations.rationale: URL design is cross-cutting; no concrete prerequisite story.

evaluations.evidence: nice error pages
evaluations.rationale: Error pages are cross-cutting; no concrete prerequisite story.

evaluations.evidence: results to be stored in a non-identifiable way
evaluations.rationale: Storing results requires games, rounds, or estimations to exist.
